reading.title: AI giant Anthropic files for an IPO that could break records
reading.summary: The AI company, which makes the popular Claude chatbot, has filed for an initial public offering that could be one of the biggest ever.

news.title: King acknowledges 'suffering of the past' as Caribbean tour begins
news.summary: The King is on a nine-day tour that will take him to three countries, including the Bahamas, Guyana and Antigua and Barbuda.
